oracle.description: templates/dispatch/hooks/tests/test-gate-log.sh decides correctness. Its REQ-005 block was written from the M-5 spec row by an author with no access to any implementation, and it also keeps every assertion the T-3 oracle already made.

purpose: Anchor the gate matcher in templates/dispatch/hooks/gate-log.sh to the command word. Today GATE_PATTERN is matched anywhere in the command string, so 'echo pytest-is-not-here-as-a-command-word' and 'git commit -m "fix pytest fixture"' both append a gate row. Nothing ran in either case, and each spurious row inflates the rework-round count the Stop hook drains into auditctl. Change the match, and only the match. A gate tool name counts when it sits on shell-word boundaries: preceded by the start of the string, whitespace, a shell separator, or a path component so 'python scripts/hybrid_dispatch.py --packet p.json gate' still counts, and followed by whitespace, a separator, or the end of the string -- optionally with an executable script suffix, so 'python verification/run_round_checks.py' still counts while 'cat pytest.ini' does not. Text inside single or double quotes is an argument to something else and must be dropped before matching. The AGENTOPS_GATE_PATTERN override selects which names are gates and is matched under the same anchoring rule; it is not an escape hatch from it. The row that gets written must still carry the ORIGINAL command in .cmd, not the stripped form. Everything else stays exactly as it is: the row shape {ts, cmd, exit, signal, ok}, the signal attribution ladder, the compound-command refusal with signal unattributable and ok null, the per-session gates-<session>.jsonl file, the jq dependency, and exiting 0 in every case including when the command does not match.
required_outcomes: a gate tool name only counts as the command word, not as an argument or as part of a longer word
text inside quotes never makes a command a gate
a path prefix and an executable script suffix still leave the name a command word
the AGENTOPS_GATE_PATTERN override is matched under the same anchoring rule
every assertion the T-3 oracle already made still holds, including the row shape and the original .cmd

acceptance_properties.requirement: a real gate command still appends exactly one well-formed row
acceptance_properties.fails_when: any of pytest, cargo test, run_round_checks, unittest discover or hybrid_dispatch gate stops producing its row

acceptance_properties.requirement: a mention is not a gate
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a tool name inside a quoted string, glued into a longer word, or used as a bare argument appends a row
a piped or && command stops recording signal unattributable with ok null

acceptance_properties.requirement: the override obeys the anchoring rule
acceptance_properties.fails_when: AGENTOPS_GATE_PATTERN is matched as a raw substring

acceptance_properties.requirement: the hook never fails its caller
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the hook exits non-zero, or writes outside gates-<session>.jsonl under AGENTOPS_GATE_LOG_DIR

non_goals: the Stop hook and its auditctl drain
the row shape or the signal attribution ladder
